source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
scope: Year 1 Unit 3 Pet Show SB34-45; guidance bank aligned to verified SOW page mapping

guidance.aims: Introduce and practise pet vocabulary in the Unit 3 opening context.
guidance.warm_up: Activate familiar animal words with picture/gesture recall.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use the opening scene to identify pets; model, listen, point and repeat the target words, then practise identification in pairs.
guidance.checking_feedback: Point to pets in mixed order and elicit names; pairs check one another.
guidance.extension_optional: Use pet picture cards for a quick memory/guessing round.

guidance.aims: Practise pet vocabulary and unit language through the textbook activity.
guidance.warm_up: Quickly recycle the pets introduced on the previous page.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Work through SB p35 using the pictures and target pet language; model the response pattern, practise chorally, then move to pair exchanges.
guidance.checking_feedback: Ask pairs to demonstrate one exchange and correct vocabulary/pronunciation as needed.
guidance.extension_optional: Pupils choose a pet and give one short clue for classmates to identify it.

guidance.aims: Develop speaking using Unit 3 pet language.
guidance.warm_up: Review pet names by showing or describing one animal at a time.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use SB p36 as the speaking stimulus; model the textbook pattern, rehearse with the class, then conduct structured pair practice.
guidance.checking_feedback: Monitor whether pupils use the target form and pet word accurately.
guidance.extension_optional: Change partners and repeat with a different pet.

guidance.aims: Consolidate Unit 3 language through the textbook follow-up task.
guidance.warm_up: Retrieve key pet words without opening the book.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use SB p37 pictures/text to complete the textbook task, compare answers in pairs, then reuse the language orally.
guidance.checking_feedback: Require pupils to point to visual/text evidence when checking answers.
guidance.extension_optional: Create one additional example using the same textbook language pattern.

guidance.aims: Follow and understand the Unit 3 picture story.
guidance.warm_up: Use the first story frame to predict characters, pets and what may happen.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Work through the SB pp38-39 story: listen/read, pause at key frames for comprehension, establish event order and replay/reread for repetition and role practice.
guidance.checking_feedback: Ask pupils to sequence key events and identify speakers/actions from the frames.
guidance.ending_lesson: Assign story roles in small groups and perform a shortened retelling.
guidance.extension_optional: Retell the story from selected picture prompts.

guidance.aims: Use the story follow-up to develop reading comprehension.
guidance.warm_up: Recall the story events orally using three or four prompts.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Reread the relevant SB p39 section, complete the follow-up comprehension task and compare evidence in pairs.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pupils explain where in the story/picture they found each answer.
guidance.extension_optional: Pairs make one extra comprehension question about the story.

guidance.aims: Practise Unit 3 language in a writing-focused textbook task.
guidance.warm_up: Orally review the words/forms pupils will need before writing.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use SB p40 as the writing model/stimulus; complete the guided task first, then produce a short individual response following the model.
guidance.checking_feedback: Use pair checking for target vocabulary and the modelled language pattern before class feedback.
guidance.extension_optional: Pupils add one additional sentence using verified Unit 3 vocabulary.

guidance.aims: Develop writing and language consolidation using the Unit 3 textbook page.
guidance.warm_up: Run a short oral retrieval of pet vocabulary.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Read/examine the SB p41 model, identify useful words or sentence frames, complete the guided task and then write independently at an appropriate Year 1 level.
guidance.checking_feedback: Partners compare work against the model and check key words.
guidance.extension_optional: Illustrate the written response and label the pet.

guidance.aims: Practise speaking from the Unit 3 textbook stimulus.
guidance.warm_up: Use picture prompts to reactivate the language needed for the task.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Model the SB p42 speaking exchange, practise as a class, then use pairs/small groups for repeated meaningful turns.
guidance.checking_feedback: Listen for correct target language and understandable pronunciation.
guidance.extension_optional: Turn the activity into a simple information-gap or guessing round.

guidance.aims: Develop reading using the Unit 3 textbook material.
guidance.warm_up: Preview the pictures/title and predict key words.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Read SB p43 for gist first, then reread for the information required by the textbook task; compare responses with a partner.
guidance.checking_feedback: Ask pupils to locate the word, phrase or picture clue supporting each response.
guidance.extension_optional: Match selected unit words to pictures or short meanings.

guidance.aims: Develop listening using the Unit 3 textbook task.
guidance.warm_up: Pre-listening review of the relevant pet vocabulary and pictures.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Study the SB p44 task before listening, listen once for the overall answer, then again for specific information; compare before whole-class checking.
guidance.checking_feedback: Replay only where needed and ask pupils what clue they heard.
guidance.extension_optional: Pairs reproduce a short oral version using the same vocabulary.

guidance.aims: Revisit SB p42 as a reading-focused SOW lesson without changing its verified page mapping.
guidance.warm_up: Recall the earlier speaking work from the same page.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Return to SB p42 and shift attention to reading/recognising the written language in the task; identify familiar words and complete the SOW-aligned reading focus.
guidance.checking_feedback: Check recognition by asking pupils to point to/read the relevant words or phrases.
guidance.extension_optional: Make a small word-picture matching set from the page.

guidance.aims: Consolidate Unit 3 through the final textbook-linked writing task.
guidance.warm_up: Review key Pet Show words and one favourite activity from the unit.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use SB p45 to complete the final Unit 3 textbook task, support pupils with the page model, then allow an individual written response.
guidance.checking_feedback: Check completion against the page model and review common language points with the class.
guidance.ending_lesson: Pupils share one thing they can now say/read/write about pets.
guidance.extension_optional: Repeat a favourite Pet Show vocabulary game.
